emergency-board-up-after-fire/commerce.intro: Emergency board up after fire in Commerce may be needed when an opening has an irregular shape after damaged trim or framing material was removed. We will review the actual condition and explain the temporary coverage that can be installed.

sections.title: Emergency board up after fire in Commerce at an altered opening
sections.text: The remaining opening may differ from the original window or door dimensions. We will assess the authorized area and identify the attachment conditions relevant to temporary protection. The plan will use the current assembly rather than rely on an old product size or a photograph from before removal.

sections.title: Explain any preparation needed first
sections.text: Loose material or an unsuitable edge may prevent the proposed installation. We will identify that limitation and explain any preparation or separate provider evaluation required. Temporary coverage will not be used to conceal a question about the remaining assembly that still needs attention.

sections.title: Record the arrangement for permanent repair
sections.text: The replacement provider will need its own measurements and evaluation. We will document what was protected and identify any return work included for access. The board-up will remain a temporary measure rather than a decision about the final opening size or reconstruction method.

emergency-board-up-after-fire/commerce.estimate: The estimate will describe the observed opening, installation and any preparation included. Later changes for inspection, measurement or replacement will be identified separately where they require another visit.
checklist: Share photographs showing the current opening.
Identify material removed since the incident.
Tell us who will evaluate permanent reconstruction.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/commerce.intro: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Commerce can be needed when a repair provider reports contamination but the owner has only a few close-up photographs. We will create a location-based account of the accessible work so the cleanup scope can be understood from above the floor.

sections.title: Crawl space sewage cleanup in Commerce with understandable location records
sections.text: Close-up images can show a problem without explaining where it sits beneath the building. We will identify the accessible affected sections using practical references and explain the proposed removal or cleaning. The record will distinguish observed areas from portions that could not be reached.

sections.title: Connect material decisions to those locations
sections.text: Debris, insulation or other components may need different handling depending on their condition. We will explain the decision for the relevant section rather than group the entire underside under one vague description. Material awaiting a further review will remain identifiable in the update.

sections.title: Use the record for the next provider
sections.text: The plumber or reconstruction contractor may need to return to a specific area. We will describe the cleanup performed and the steps still pending there. A location-based account supports that visit without implying that every inaccessible section has been evaluated or restored.

crawl-space-sewage-cleanup/commerce.estimate: The estimate will state the accessible areas and material work included. Source correction and replacement tasks will remain separate, with any new findings after improved access explained before additional work is authorized.
checklist: Share the original provider photographs and notes.
Identify known access openings.
Tell us which repair provider needs the completed-work record.
